title: Band-9 Samples: What could you do to have a healthier lifestyle?
passage_text: This post contains ideas and band-9 sample answers (audio included) for the Cambridge IELTS 12 Academic Speaking Part 1 Question 4 Test 1 question: “What could you do to have a healthier lifestyle?” Sample 1 Female Male To be honest, one way I could enhance my well-being is by exercising some self-discipline. I often find myself drinking beer with colleagues after work, which is a social ritual but not really beneficial for my health. I reckon cutting down on this habit would make a monumental difference. It’s not just about reducing alcohol intake, it’s about having more control over my time and my choices. Sample 2 Female Male You know, the secret to a more healthful existence might just be finding joy in the simple things of life. Instead of pouring our energy into constant professional endeavors, taking time to appreciate the beauty around us could be transformative. It could be something as simple as observing a sunset, reading a book, or spending time with loved ones. This shift in focus could lead to a more relaxed mind, which in turn could contribute to overall health improvement. Sample 3 Female Male A strategy I could pursue to enhance my well-being is to adopt a plant-based diet. It’s a nutrition plan that primarily includes fruits, vegetables, legumes, and whole grains. The idea is that these foods are rich in essential vitamins and minerals that can help improve my bodily functions. The transition wouldn’t be easy, but I believe the potential benefits, such as a lower risk of heart disease, make it worth considering. Sample 4 Female Male To lead a more healthful existence, I could take up a sport or a physical activity I enjoy. Engaging in such activities not only promotes cardiovascular health but also contributes to mental well-being. I could join a dance class or start swimming, for instance, which would not only improve my fitness but also provide a social outlet. Sample 5 Female Male As a university student, one strategy I’d employ to lead a healthier lifestyle would be to minimize the frequency of eating out. Often, campus life can lead to a reliance on fast food or cafeteria meals, which aren’t always the healthiest options. By cooking more meals in my dorm or apartment, I can ensure I’m consuming wholesome, nutrient-rich foods. This not only benefits my physical health but also promotes a routine of self-care and mindfulness toward what I fuel my body with. Sample 6 Female Male One effective method to boost my health might be to reduce my screen time. The blue light emitted from screens can disrupt our sleep patterns which leads to fatigue and decreased productivity. By setting strict boundaries for using digital devices, I could sleep better and have more energy during the day. Sample 7 Female Male To ensure a healthier lifestyle, I could make it a habit to have regular health check-ups. These visits to the doctor can help catch any health issues early, making treatment more effective. While it might seem unnecessary when feeling healthy, it’s definitely a proactive measure that could potentially save my life in the future. Sample 8 Female Male A simple, yet often neglected way to improve my health could be to ensure proper hydration and adequate rest. Drinking enough water can help maintain the balance of bodily fluids and regulate body temperature. Meanwhile, getting enough sleep can enhance cognitive functions and overall mood. Both these changes are easy to implement but can have profound effects on overall health. Sample 9 Female Male Well, I think I’ve already got a pretty decent regimen in place when it comes to physical health, but if I had to improve on something, it would probably be focusing more on mental wellness. You know, incorporating mindful activities like meditation or yoga, perhaps even reading more to broaden my knowledge and relax my mind. Mental health is just as important as physical health, and it’s something I could definitely pay more attention to. Sample 10 Female Male Honestly, I believe I’m leading a pretty healthy life since I’m a big fan of the outdoors. I regularly go hiking, cycling, and swimming, which are excellent for cardiovascular health. Plus, being in nature keeps me mentally rejuvenated. Considering this, I can’t really think of any substantial modifications that I’d need to make to my lifestyle at the moment.
